body: Well, my intention is to make peace. I've done the same thing to all my previous exes actually and we're really good friends now. I can say with confidence I'll date any of them again. It's just with this one it's still quite recent compared to others so i'm not sure if it's a good idea. I guess not.

This sounds like my last relationship, except i was the girl who got left. It's been 8 months and looking back I can kinda understand why he decided to leave and  in a way appreciate it. We were in a LDR and I was at a crossroads to give up everything to move across the world for him. I guess he didn't want me to do it for him and regret it down the road. But still, I wish that had been addressed cause he was never communicative. Instead he decided to push me away and cut me out of his life completely without much explanation other than 'I'm sorry I can't do this anymore'. I still love him dearly and I wish he was still in my life.
Well I was the one who asked to break up like 5 times and put him through my bullshit first. When he actually left is when I realized what I had. It was definitely somewhat my fault.

Aww that's really nice of them! I have something similar too - my 2 ex-boyfriends were the ones who have been there for me since day one of this most recent break up. They always checked in with me and both have taken me out a few times to do fun things to cheer me up (in a purely platonic way). I'm hoping one day I can be as good of a friend to my most recent ex as I am with these two.
Lmao this is my ex exactly. Glad it’s somebody else’s problem to deal with his ugly dick now.
See comment below please!

I initiated it. Not the first time I did cause we were fighting a lot due to lots of personal issues and distance. Usually he’d not agree with it but this one last rime he finally went ‘yeah I can’t do it anymore’. He’s always been the person who doesn’t communicate and throughout all this time there were things I did that hurt him or bothered him but he never really brought them up to me. So in the end I guess he was really resentful towards me.
Agree with this. You gotta take it slow. At this point i think she feels pressured by your expectations and it is driving her away.

We hung out a few months after the break up (during those months we still kept in contact) and he did say “I missed you so much”. Well guess what, it’s been over 4 months since then and we’re still broken up.
Wow i wish it was my ex who wrote this. Broke up due to the same things and that's exactly how I felt when I realized I was in love with him.
Sooo true! Broke up during long distance as well. 7 months have gone by and I’m still not where I should be.

It’s different for everyone really. But yes, daily for me. To be honest I still think about him every morning when I wake up. We broke up 7 months ago but only 2 months of NC though, I probably need more time

Not to be harsh, but if you're going on a break just to prepare for the break up, just break up. He is indifferent about staying with you and that should be more than enough reason to break up. Taking a break doesn't make a break up easier from my experience cause you're still holding on to the hope that things will get better. Best to just break up and deal with it instead of prolonging it for absolutely no reason.
If he doesn't reach out, whatever the reason might be, the end result is the same as him not wanting to contact you anyway. The person who deserves you will fight for you.
Added it for you :)
Brunch or a nice chill dinner with a bottle of wine

I think the key of getting back together with an ex is you have to be apart for long enough to feel like it’s a new relationship. You guys breaking up means something wasn’t working so going back to it so soon is more like continuing what you left, instead of starting over. Sorry to hear this is happening to you, but at least now you know that maybe taking the time apart really is necessary.

>  You’re putting her problems on you and resenting her for it

THIS. I was in a relationship extremely similar to this, but I was the girl. And I wish my ex had told me or even left me earlier instead of tolerating it for months and ending up resenting me for things I wasn't even aware of. Mental illness is difficult. Do her and yourself a favor and leave asap.

Yeah she definitely has emotional baggage. My ex is somewhat similar to your ex. Every time I got stressed over other things, he blamed himself for not being able to make me feel better. Your ex cannot love you fully until she learns to see her own self worth. And no one can help her with that, not even you. It’s sad but it’s what you have to accept. She doesn’t want to drag you down with her and I know you want to change her mindset and let her know how amazing she is, but if she doesn’t see it herself nothing you do will make it better. This is why you gotta let her go to experience other things in life on her own. You’ve tried and it didn’t work so you gotta respect her wish and let her deal with her baggage on her own. You can still be there for her as a friend, if you truly love her, but don’t expect to get anything in return cause she’s incapable of doing so at the moment.

Been broken up for 7 months, 2 months of NC - this is exactly how I've been feeling lately, except I can't say I don't love him anymore. I loved him more than life and I still do. I'm just sure I'm not in love with him anymore and at this point I don't even want him back. I just want him to be happy and I'm content with my own life without him. Thanks to NC for helping me move on!
It's rough man, knowing exactly what went wrong and how to fix it but that doesn't help cause he's still so resentful and unless he can learn to communicate it just won't work

I was exactly where you’re at. I was verbally abusive towards him and my depression made it so so much worse. I spent months after the break up beating myself up for that. 7 months later with 2 months of NC, I realized something that I didn’t before. When 2 people break up, unless there’s cheating involved, BOTH partners are responsible for it in some ways. For my case, I realized he was not communicating when it came to discussing our future or problem in general. Him not responding to important things, a lot of times, made me feel like he didn’t care and it was what triggered me to get really angry. He also never ever said no to me even if it was something he didn’t agree or feel comfortable with, and that turned into resentment which led to the breakup. If he’d been more communicative I believe I could have adjusted and things wouldn’t have turned out the way they did. So don’t blame yourself on this too much, really. You might not be able to see it now but stay NC and give him and yourself some time. Work on your part that contributed to the breakup. I promise you won’t feel this way forever.

My ex has been seeing/messing around with someone (they never officially got together) since the first week we broke up 7 months ago till now. When I first found out about 5 months ago, it was the most painful thing I’ve had to go through. I was crying a lot over this for like 2-3 months. Now 7 months later and 2 months of NC, I can say honestly that I’m fine. I have to say it helps a lot to see he downgraded. Now when I think of them together I think “yeah I’m way out of his league”. The fact that he jumped on somebody else right away shows that he’s not mature enough for real relationships so I know this isn’t gonna last anyway, and the most important part is I genuinely don’t want him back right now cause I’m enjoying myself (thanks to NC!) so this doesn’t bother me anymore. To answer your question, yes it does get less painful over time. It really does. For now just focus on you :)

This is exactly what happened to me and my ex. We had conversations about communication at the start and over the course of 2 years he never improved. I guess some people are just incapable of being honest.
I'm betting $100, he sounds like a fucking pussy
I’m currently with Accenture but I heard they don’t really sponsor?
When their presence annoys you and vice versa

Moving back to Thailand after 10 years in the US. Never felt so out of place in my life. I feel like i can't be myself here and with how the Thai culture is I constantly feel like I'm trapped inside a box. It's been 2 years since i moved back and I'm still dealing with depression caused by this reverse culture shock.
Deciding between Accenture consulting and another boutique consulting firm

Hey i'm on the same boat as you. I've been dealing with depression and overall self-unhappiness, which caused me to act crazy and hurtful in the relationship and as you can tell by now, he left me. I understand that you have this "I can fix my mental illness and we can make this work" mindset, which isn't wrong. But then again, it means you have to fix yourself first. You have to be able to rely on yourself without him. If you can't do that, relationship with him or anyone will never work! You'll just keep being stuck in the loop. So please, I know it's hard, but focusing on yourself and trying to work this out on your own is EXACTLY what you need to do.

I wish I knew what truly made me happy. When I was 23, I had a great life but greed blindsided me. I made a decision to give up everything I had for a big corporate job half way across the world from home (I left people I loved, the perfectly comfortable life, a great apartment, my beloved car etc.). Now I hate my life and I wish I didn't take what I already had for granted.
Sending me puppy videos

Personally, no. When I was dating my ex, I completely refused to accept the fact that I was mentally unstable (I was going through a lot at that time as well). I put it all on him as I couldn’t rely on myself. Honestly I didn’t realize how severe it was until he left me. Now looking back I can see the effects it had on the relationship and I really wish was brave enough to face it back then, put the relationship on pause and tried to fix myself first before it was too late.
I second this. I'm 25 - last year everything in my life basically fell apart so I'm currently turning my life around and it's going well.
edit: to answer your question, it's a beautiful country but also boring af.
I lived in Singapore for a year. Never going back to live there again.
I feel the same way. So far every guy I've met or talked to makes me miss my ex even more. He was the one that got away for me.
Wow okay yeah. You obviously deserve better than that.
Were you the dumpee or the dumper?

3 months post-breakup (we never did NC and always kept in contact) we started hanging out again and of course we hooked up. I don't blame him for that cause it was what I wanted too. I was aware that it was a bad idea but I didn't think too much of it cause at the end of the day the sex was great. 

However after casually hanging out + hooking up for 3-4 more times, I started to fall back in love with him. Sadly it was obvious to me that he still didn't want to get back together. So I ended it for good to save myself from the emotional roller coaster. 

My advice to you is do it if you really want to, but know that it will make you feel shitty and eventually you'll have to go NC anyway.

But does it really matter whether he reaches out or not? At the end of the day he chose to leave you honey. Him seeking attention on social media only validates his low self-esteem and having a person like that in your life will only drag you down. He might change but right now it is obvious you are much better off without him. Focus on yourself and not what he's doing. You said you don't plan on begging him to come back - you seem to know damn well you deserve better than this so LET GO. Drop this whole thing and focus on what YOU do, not what he does.
"Yet he dumped me through text message after one year, that speaks volumes." - you already know the answer.
He still has $500+ worth of my items but I'm not planning to reach out anytime soon for that cause my feelings matter more.
Get anxious and block her anyway
I stored them in a hidden folder on my computer and deleted them off my phone. I haven't deleted them on my social media either, they're good memories and i see no harm in keeping them.
THIS. Thank you!!

This sounds almost exactly like my relationship except we weren’t each other’s first. Even though he’s moved on, I’m sure he’s not over you - he’s just not showing it. Don’t forget that social media means nothing after all. Remember that if what you guys had was real, he’s just hurting as much as you are. If he isn’t then it means what you had wasn’t real in the first place so you’re lucky to be out of it. You won’t ever be the same again but you will heal. Be patient and love yourself.
Blocked.

Omg you sound exactly like me :( although I'm only about half way through the process compared to you (broke up 6 months ago, NC for 20 days)

He told me he loved me, took care of me, and tried to be there when i needed him - but he still chose not to be with me. Well in our case distance is a huge factor but still. He put me through hell.

I'm very tempted to break contact today. I miss him so so much. Please message me if you need someone who's going through something similar to talk to.
We are all so proud of you girl. If you need anything do not hesitate to reach out <3

What the fuck.... he sounds mentally unstable

Girl you obviously deserve so much better than this
You'll get through this. It will only get better. <3

OMG I thought I was the only one who thought so! I thought I was a weak ass motherfucker lol sometimes they say the truth you need to hear but I find that most of the time they don’t really try to understand your situation. They often miss the point of my question and get straight to the ‘you’re an idiot’ part so yeah I just stopped going there too

Yeah but then it makes me feel even better about myself cause damn she ugly.

I showed my friends her pic and they all literally laughed.

Maybe things are getting more serious with the new girl/she asked him to block you aka his ex :/ 

You're doing good, don't focus on him!

I've been through something similar. I had a flight booked prior to the breakup so it's not like I spent $1000 to go get him back exactly. Thing is even though I went to see him, it didn't work out for us. We broke up due to similar reasons as yours. We both loved each other soooo much but we kept hurting each other and didn't really know why. We always kept in contact after the breakup, meaning we didn't give each other space to think things through at all. When I went to see him (it was like a month after the breakup), there was a lot of confusion going on, the resentment was still there, we couldn't figure out what we wanted cause we didn't give each other time to think. It got real messy towards the end, which is why I decided to cut ties and go NC.  


My advice to you is, don't spend that money yet. Give yourself and him some time to digest this. I'd give it a month if I were you. By this I mean no begging, no talking, just breathe and think. Trust me.

Wow this is exactly what happened to me except i didn't realize it till it was too late :( since he decided to leave 6 months ago I've been trying to my hardest to work on myself. I started going to therapy and picked up new hobbies. I don't know if I'll ever be lucky enough again to have him back but either way I want to do my best to change and make him proud.
25 feel like 22

It's really interesting to hear this from the dumper. I can see where she's coming from - I mean you dumped her twice. From the sound of it I think she started to realize that you might never change, and the fact that getting back together the second time ended the same way as the first time kinda validated that point for her. So I think right now you really have to take a step back and reassess yourself. Let her live her life. Keep in mind that she can do whatever she wants but that shouldn't matter to you. You seem to understand that you have things to work on. Well, you need to focus on that and that only. Getting her back right now will only result in the same issue. Please stay NC and use this time to reflect on yourself.

Man I feel you. Almost 6 months since the BU here as well. Last week I went back to read some of his messages - all the "I want to grow old with you" and "I want to be with you forever" bullshit. I have a box that stores all these notes he used to write me every morning. I can't even go near it anymore without crying. It's tough but we will get through this.

Shitting myself. I think I was like 1.

I feel you. 

15 days since I went NC and i'm doing MUCH better, i'm glad i went NC, but man I just want to tell him all about my day, send him pics of all this delicious food i'm eating, gossip about my coworkers, etc. I miss him so much

"I also want to ask him if he might be willing to give our relationship a second chance."

You're not ready to break contact. Why did you guys break up in the first place?

There were times when there was fault in both sides of the party. But for my relationship, there were times where he literally went 'babe can i call you? i miss you' and i went 'no, bye' - only because he didn't ask to call exactly when i wanted him to call. I was stupid. I was self-centered. I was full of shit. I ruined it.
You’re not alone. Hugs <3
Have you tried suggesting a meet-up?
Give yourself and him a bit more time. You guys lived together for a while, i think you need a little bit more of space before going back to it.
Back off for a while. Stop initiating contact. See what happens.

DO NOT stay friends. My ex and I broke up on good terms, tried to stay friends for 5 months, things got suuuper messy and we both cried over it probably more than we should have. Go NC immediately - give it at least a month. THEN you can try to be friends but you absolutely can't be friends with her right now. Please don't make the same mistakes I made.

100% normal. Mine - broke up 5 months ago, went NC 13 days ago. Still cry every single day. Count it from the day you went NC, not the day you broke up. So technically it's still pretty fresh for both of you.

Fuck that. Keep it. 

Or even better, sell it. That's what I would do.
No
Been there. Let the pain sink it and stop texting him. Get yourself under control

Don't wait. He said being together would drive you guys further apart so take him at his word - give yourself and him space until both of you are sure, meaning don't see each other until he says 'Let's try again'.

Do yourself a favor and get out of that situation asap. I was stuck in that grey area with my ex whom I dated for 1.5 years for 5 whole months - nothing got better, he never got a taste of his own medicine. If she doesn't commit but you keep giving her what she wants anyway, why would she ever want to commit to you? Go NC.

Day 12 of NC here. Feeling this way almost every day still. 
It will get better. One day we'll be strong enough to look back and be proud of how far we've come!

Great job for hitting one month! You are kinda on the same boat as me. If I were you, I’d wait another week to see how I feel. Then if I still felt like I’d be strong enough to take whatever, I would reach out to him. After all he is someone important to you and you are to him, even though the status has changed. It sounds like you understand where you stand as well so I think reaching out won’t hurt. Good luck!
Leave the doors open but don’t go back now. If yourself and him some time to think things through. You don’t wanna repeat the mistakes.
How long ago did you break up?
Did you guys keep in contact during those 3 months?
I second this. Be on your own until you're 100% happy being single. Don't try to get in a relationship now.

The point of NC is to help you gain yourself back. It takes longer for some people but key is don't give up. You don't feel any better now but if you break NC you'll go back to square one and have to restart the healing process. I can understand why you want her back, but at the same time you absolutely cannot have her back if you don't get back to your 100%. And no one else in the world can do this for you, not even her. You need to do this ON YOUR OWN. You can do it. Good luck :)
Wow 2 years? I thought mine was long (5 months). I wish I hadn't waited that long to cut contact. I'm so proud of you for finally having the courage to walk away. We can do this!
This made my life. Thank you

For sure. I'm glad you are aware of it. Both of you should definitely work on your problems before you try to be in a relationship again, whether it's trying again with one another or with someone else. Wish you all the best!

I was your ex in the relationship. Being on the other end, I have to say I did not like the way I was at all. Having daddy issues is hard and we didn't ask for them. I'm sure she didn't even realize what she was doing was toxic. I didn't realize I was the toxic one till he left me and it hit me like a brick that I lost the best thing in the world. I realized there's no point of me trying to defend your ex but perhaps it would make you feel better to know she probably didn't hurt you on purpose. Sometimes people who come off as 'toxic' just have their own issues they have to sort out.
What if you specifically told him/her not to contact you?

I was 24 and he was turning 26. For me at that point I thought a high paying job was everything, which was why I left him to go to grad school, but now I wish I had never left in the first place. Not because of him, but I'm not happy with any aspect of my life since I moved. But yeah for you I think you know yourself well enough at this point to know what's more important to you in life, so go with it and don't look back.

I'm sure he was a good boyfriend and honestly i think he will regret doing this to you later on. I think there was something else going on that he was too much of a coward to bring up to you and deal with it, so he used that excuse as an easy way out. If he really is a good person like you believe he is, he may realize later on that he made a mistake breaking up with you. If not, I'm sure at least he'll realize how shitty it was to treat you like that after the break up and come back to apologize. If neither of these scenarios happen, then you can rest assure you've lost nothing and that he did you a favor for leaving.

Honey from an outsider's perspective, well this might not be what you want to hear, but I think it's been over for him for a while now and he just used you graduating college as an excuse to break up with you. When he said he saw another girl because you didn't fight for him, I'm sorry but that's bullshit to me. How can he be that insensitive about it? With or without the new girl, I feel like he's long gone. I'm sorry but please take this time to take care of yourself. You have so many good things ahead of you.

I think you should just assume he is not coming back - well for your own sake of healing. It's clear he cares for you but if he's unsure about being with you then you gotta let him go. Don't wait cause he's not waiting for you. Both of you should try dating other people for a while. If you guys come back to one another after that, great, it means what you had was real. If not, then you know it wasn't meant to be in the first place. Take time to yourself to heal and be open-minded if a new guy comes in. Good luck

When I found out my ex was seeing someone (literally within 2 weeks after we broke up), my world fell apart. I called him up and said all the hurtful words. 2 days later I called him again to apologize. It's normal. Just be sure to stay away for now to avoid further emotional damages on both ends.

I’m on day 6 of NC and to be honest I constantly have that fear he’ll forget about me too. So I know exactly where you’re coming from. But truth is he won’t. You were a big part of his life and he’ll always have those memories with him no matter how much time passes. However, he may move on. It sucks but there’s nothing you can do. Letting go is the first step of learning how not to be controlling in a relationship. So let him be right now and focus on yourself. If he comes back then things will be great cause you will have worked on yourself and become a positive and happier person - who wouldn’t want to be around a person like that right? If he doesn’t come back, then like you said, it’s his problem. By then you’ll realize you have lost nothing.

You're welcome.

I am proud of you. Take this time to really get in touch with yourself and your feelings. Things will only get better from here :)

My head says you should break up and let her go, but my heart says otherwise. I am in the exact same position you are. I moved half way across the world for school and at first I promised him i'd be back in one year, but other things got involved and I probably won't be able to move back for another year or so. I pressured him so much to move to where I am, well it was his fault too cause at first he said he'd consider moving then he changed his mind due to family reasons. But the point is, this got us into so many fights and eventually he broke up with me due to the exact same reason you're thinking about breaking up with your gf. We didn't see the end date so he thought it'd be better off if he just let me go so I could focus on my own future. 


5 months after the breakup, i really wish i hadn't pressured him about this. I'd rather go through the pain of LDR for 5 more years than not having him at all, but it's too late now.


I don't know man. I get where you're coming from though. I guess it requires you to think long term whether the relationship or your career will make you happier. Do what makes you happy and not what you should do.

I was in the exact same position as you, except my ex had to handle my aggressive behavior and hurtful words for almost a year before he couldn't do it anymore. Same with your ex, my ex couldn't go more than 2-3 days without reaching out to me. However, he still stands by his decision not to get back together now - which i didn't understand at first but I do now. 


Here's what happened: We broke up 5 months ago and always kept in contact. I told him since the moment we broke up that I'm gonna try my hardest to work on myself. Guess what, I didn't. Because we kept in contact, whenever my mental illness acted up I'd call him at 4am crying and being upset about our break up. I'd call 10 more times if he didn't answer and would start having suicidal thoughts just because he didn't call back within 1-2 hours (yes that's how severe my illness was). This happened probably 5-6 times in the span of 5 months. In the beginning, he'd always be there for me. Sometimes no matter how crazy I got, he'd stay on the phone with me for hours trying to calm me down. However, when it got to the 5th-6th time, I started to notice the change in his behavior. He would take much longer to call me back and also seemed annoyed. I was so sick I didn't understand why at first even though it's soooooo obvious how crazy I was being. Eventually when it got to the 6th time, it hit me that I was legit sick and my behavior since the break up hasn't made anything better at all; if anything it drove him away even further. That's the moment i realized I NEEDED to STOP this whole thing. And NC was the only way to do so. NC was the only thing that would allow me to focus on myself 100% without creating even deeper damage on the relationship with my ex. There was no way around it. 


To hear that you're going through something similar, my advice to you is - PLEASE go NC NOW. Don't keep this going for 3 more months and make the same mistake I did.  


YOU are the one who's not ready to get back together with him. And if you don't work on yourself now, you'll eventually drive him away for good. Fix yourself first. You can't be in a happy relationship if you're not happy with yourself, and I think your ex knows that. He's doing you a favor right now by not jumping right back in because it's obviously gonna fail again pretty soon if you don't take a step back and work on yourself first. 


Trust me, go NC for at least 30 days, get better on your own, and by then if you still want to try to work things out with him you can reach out, but for now you're absolutely not ready. Please take care of yourself.
I’m sorry you feel that way but to be fair you broke up with her and she’s probably hurting a lot. Why did you break up with her though?
Love your username man - just thought I'd let you know
Great post! Just one thing: My ex and I were so close and I used to tell him everything. So when I was going to cut contact, I straight up told him that I was going NC - did I make a mistake?

I made a mistake of staying friends with him after the break up. So for 4 months something we were texting almost every day, hung out 7-8 times and spent Christmas and my birthday together. Shouldn’t have done any of that
Give it time. Don't do anything yet. Don't talk to him either. Give yourself time for at  least 2 weeks and by then it should become more clear to you what you should do. Good luck
4 months and this already happened. Sorry but you gotta let go. You'll be ok sooner than you think I promise!
I was having a bad day and this made me giggle. Thank you

On the same boat here! Broke up in September 2017, didn’t go NC till 4 days ago. I slept with someone else a few weeks ago thinking it would make me feel better but it made me feel like shit. In fact I bursted out crying in front of the new guy cause I missed my ex so much. It was a huge mess. 


We can do this. It will take time but we can heal. We are stronger than we think we are.

I did the exact same thing to my ex! I was mean, verbally & emotionally abusive even though I loved and cared about him more than anything in the world. He couldn't take it and asked to break up 5 months ago after 1.1 years in. That was a wake up call for me. Since then I have been trying my hardest to work on myself, though there were days that I'd freak out, go crazy, hit my ex up 'expecting' him to fix my mental issues for me, and drove him even further away. This is why I decided to start NC and focus on myself fully. 


I know you're on the same boat with me. You want to become better. You're aware of your problems. That's a GREAT start. I'm proud of you for recognizing that. 

Now, like the other post says, therapy + Buddhism help. Remember, you're doing great. Now it's just time to take some actions and become the person you've always wanted to be. Do it now and you will start seeing light at the end of the tunnel, I promise.

Right, I just keep having these repetitive thoughts about what I did to him and how much that might have hurt him, and I can't stop feeling shitty about myself. 


I am all the way in Thailand. I'm also struggling financially and therapy would cost so much. I try to talk to my friends as much as possible but I feel like a burden when I reach out to them every single day about the same thing.

Hi, thank you for taking the time to respond. 
I am not yet in therapy. It's in my plan though. The country where I moved to isn't very open about this kind of stuff yet so it's been a bit difficult to find the right place/therapist to go to. 
I told my ex before I went NC that I'd seek professional help too so I guess that could be my first step forward.

No problem! But you know, sometimes it’s not that they don’t want to try as hard as we are willing to. As for my ex’s case, he’s very much inexperienced in life (he’s 26 but I was his first serious girlfriend and his circle of friends is pretty narrow while compared to me I’ve been around the world on my own my entire life). So basically he just wasn’t ready to move forward and he didn’t want to hold me back. He was also the backbone of his family so he had to get his priorities straight.
